D-LAS also fails the line-of-fire backstop check.

input.own_assessment: T-1 is one Group 1 quadcopter. The camera has a visual ID, with blade spin seen and no payload (S-GIM 08:21:40, 08:22:00). It flies erratically over water off the base beach, around (-1605, 531), at about 55-75 m by radar and camera. Hobby protocol, live control link, no Remote ID (S-RF). S-RF puts the pilot on the base beach near (-1822, -12), error 60 m. Check_site_zone confirms that point is Z-BEACH, which is on base. The track is not heading at a critical asset, and base housing is 1,731 m away. S-ACO is degraded (H-03) and I ignore it. S-RF drone altitude is erratic, and S-WAC altitude is noisy; both are unexplained and I treat them as caution flags only. Weather is good. Alert is ELEVATED (N-02). I assess the threat as LOW to MEDIUM. No Remote ID is the main indicator. Rung 2 (ROE-6.1, send security to the pilot) is allowed at any level from LOW and needs operator approval (ROE-4.1). Rungs 3 and above are blocked by the control room stop (ROE-4.4). D-LAS fails the geometry check because the backstop crosses Z-APPR. D-GUN fails sector, elevation band and backstop. D-INT and D-LAS also need HIGH threat, and D-GUN needs CRITICAL.

discrepancies.correct_fact: check_site_zone at the S-GIM position (-1605, 531) gives 1,731 m to Z-HOUSE. This does not change the result.

discrepancies.issue: The analyst treats Z-APPR as a never-backstop without noting the activity condition. Per N-12, Z-APPR is in use only when the tower reports traffic. The analyst does say to ask the tower.
discrepancies.correct_fact: The backstop is 'never' only when aircraft are active, and the activity is not known. The D-LAS geometry check still reports failure, and the control room stop independently blocks rung 3 and above, so the blocked status stands.

S-RF puts the pilot on the base beach near (-1822, -12), error 60 m. Check_site_zone confirms that point is Z-BEACH, which is on base. The track is not heading at a critical asset, and base housing is 1,731 m away. S-ACO is degraded (H-03) and I ignore it. S-RF drone altitude is erratic, and S-WAC altitude is noisy; both are unexplained and I treat them as caution flags only. Weather is good. Alert is ELEVATED (N-02). I assess the threat as LOW to MEDIUM. No Remote ID is the main indicator. Rung 2 (ROE-6.1, send security to the pilot) is allowed at any level from LOW and needs operator approval (ROE-4.1). Rungs 3 and above are blocked by the control room stop (ROE-4.4). D-LAS fails the geometry check because the backstop crosses Z-APPR. D-GUN fails sector, elevation band and backstop. D-INT and D-LAS also need HIGH threat, and D-GUN needs CRITICAL.

discrepancies.correct_fact: The backstop is 'never' only when aircraft are active, and the activity is not known. The D-LAS geometry check still reports failure, and the control room stop independently blocks rung 3 and above, so the blocked status stands.
